description: Four small plastic cups (blue, yellow, red, and green) sit in a row on the counter, with a blue scrub sponge in front and a yellow squeeze bottle off to the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the green cup and lifts it toward the center as the right hand picks up the yellow bottle and brings its tip to the cup’s opening, then the left hand holds the green cup steady while the right hand switches to the blue sponge and pushes it down into the cup to scrub inside, making small twisting and pressing motions.
